{{Quote|You give me the inventory of all the farmland lying fallow, and my clan will make sure it gets allocated to whoever returns to farm it.|[[Baltan Carid]]|<ref name="Sacrifice" />}}
'''Clan Carid''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clan living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] during the time of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. Mandalorian [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Baltan Carid]] was a [[Chief/Legends|leader]] of the clan, and represented Clan Carid during a meeting of the Mandalorian clans with reigning [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] at [[MandalMotors Hall]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]]. When Fett called for two million Mandalorians living offworld to return to their cultural [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]—part of initiative to boost the planet's population in the wake of the [[Battle of Mandalore (Yuuzhan Vong War)|devastation]] incured upon Mandalore during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|war]] with the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]]—Baltan offered his clan's services in ensuring that the unused [[Farm/Legends|farmland]] that had been left behind after the former owners had [[Death/Legends|perished]] would be given to any new arrivals who claimed interest in [[Farmer/Legends|farming]] it.<ref name="Sacrifice" /> By early [[41 ABY]], Mandalorians from across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] were returning to Mandalore, and Clan Carid lived up to Baltan's vow, ensuring that the fallow land was given to new owners to revitalize.<ref name="Revelation">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref>
